sentences.text: I t is submitted by learned counsel appearing for appellant that prosecutrix has been examined and after examination of prosecutrix, earlier bail application has been dismissed by this Court.
Appellant is in jail since 31.10.2021 for about two years.
Considering the aforesaid circumstance, he prayed that the appellant may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the bail application.
It is submitted that there is direct allegations made against the appellant by prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix has stated that appellant has committed rape on her in his house.
She went to the house of appellant to give him Bananas and thereafter, he pulled her in and closed the room and committed the act of rape.
In these circumstances, he prayed for dismissal of criminal appeal for grant of bail.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
6.
Act of rape is said to have been committed in the house of appellant and prosecutrix had gone to the house of appellant.
Appellant is in jail for last two years.
He is young man aged about 21 years.
7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and also long custody period and age of appellant, I find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
Hence, this criminal appeal filed by appellant is allowed.

8. It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) by the appellant along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, the appellant be released on bail.
